content.rationale: The checks are where D16c's exercising, D9's three checks (validity, resolution, and kwwsoosw's coverage), O10's line rendering, the per-verb --help promise, and the argument refusal (C) meet; this check drives the handler over scratch repos whose node files are named by real change ids and pins each failure line to the check that produced it — a clean graph silent, an invalid node, an unresolved target, an uncovered decision edge, and the root edge out of scope, and that the handler is the table's shape — a `Verb` row for it compiles (M-route). It reaches store_list/store_resolve/store_load, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive, and I1-schema (`zmmyomyp`) fixes the validator these documents are checked with. It pins the read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn): an unreadable node is a validity line, never a silent skip. It also pins the crossing rule (D-read-bulk, rkoktpwt) and set-backed resolution (S2-resolve-in-set, opqlqqvu): two fixtures with the same node count and different edge counts make the same number of `file show` crossings and report the same lines, so the resolution per edge no longer adds a read.
